seoTitle: How to Loop Animation in Canva for Continuous Motion
metaDescription: Create continuous, looping animations in Canva using styles like pulse and spin, then export as a seamless GIF or MP4 file.
intro: Eye-catching designs that never stop moving rely on continuous animation styles applied thoughtfully across your elements and timeline. Canva offers built-in looping animation styles like pulse, blink, and spin, plus timeline tools to extend your project so the final export loops seamlessly. This guide covers the full setup.

steps.heading: Open the Animate menu
steps.body: Select an element on your canvas and open its animation settings.

steps.heading: Choose a continuous animation style
steps.body: Browse the Continuous Animations category for options like breathe, spin, and wiggle.

steps.heading: Customize speed and direction
steps.body: Adjust the speed and intensity sliders to fine-tune how the looping effect looks.

steps.heading: Extend background elements
steps.body: Set background or repeating elements to keep moving indefinitely throughout the design.

steps.heading: Adjust page timing
steps.body: Use the timeline editor to set page duration and duplicate pages for extended video playback.

steps.heading: Export as a looping GIF or MP4
steps.body: Download your finished design as an infinite looping GIF or MP4 file.

faq.question: What animation styles are best for a continuous loop?
faq.answer: Continuous animation styles like breathe, spin, and wiggle are specifically designed to repeat indefinitely, unlike entrance or exit animations.

faq.question: Can I export a looping animation as a GIF?
faq.answer: Yes, Canva supports exporting your animated design as either a looping GIF or an MP4 video file.

faq.question: Why does my exported video stop instead of looping?
faq.answer: This often happens when the page timeline isn't extended or duplicated properly, so the animation runs out of duration before it can repeat.

faq.question: Can I control how fast the loop cycles?
faq.answer: Yes, speed and intensity sliders let you customize how quickly the continuous animation moves.
